title: Qalanak taypin Chimpu
intro: Mä uraqinx qullunakax utanakar ch’uqt’atänwa, mä yatiyirix Allah ukan mä milagro señal apt’ataw purinïna. Jaqinakax prueba mayipxäna, ukat mä creatura solida qalat katuqapxäna. Ukampis jachʼa jachʼa tukutapatjja, uka ewjjtʼaruw jan istʼapkänti, ukhamatwa kunatï pasañapäkäna uk sellapjjäna.
clues: Nayarojj mä markaruw khitapjjetäna, jupanakajj qollunakat kʼachachtʼat utanakanwa jakasipjjäna.
Mä letrero apaniñajatakiw chʼamañchtʼapjjetäna, ukatwa mä qarqat mä camello apsuyäta.
Nayajj camellor jan kuna jan waltʼäwin umañapatak jaytapjjañapatakiw mayïta.
Jan istʼasaw camellorojj chʼakhanakap chʼoqtʼapjjäna, nayajj ewjjtʼajar jan istʼasa.
Kimsa urut castigojj jutaniwa sasaw yatiyta.
Alwajja, mä jachʼa phallawiw jupanakar tʼunjäna, ukampis nayasa ukat arkirinakajasa qhespiyapjjayätwa.

options: Mä qalat mä camello warmi mayiña

trial.answer: Mä qalat mä camello warmi mayiña

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَـٰلِحًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَإِذَا هُمْ فَرِيقَانِ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
verse: And We had certainly sent to Thamūd their brother Ṣāliḥ, [saying], "Worship Allāh," and at once they were two parties conflicting. (27:45)
